patterns.name: Architectural layer violation — presentation layer directly accesses data layer
patterns.description: A file in the presentation layer (handler, api, controller, route) directly imports a package from the data layer (repo, repository, dal), skipping the service layer. This creates tight coupling between HTTP handling and data storage, breaking testability and violating the separation of concerns principle.
patterns.message: File {file} is in the {src_layer} layer but directly imports '{target}' which is in the {dst_layer} layer. Route all data access through the {skip_layer} layer to preserve separation of concerns and testability.

patterns.name: Admin route or handler missing elevated authorization
patterns.description: A route or handler identified as admin-level (path contains /admin, /management, or similar) does not apply elevated authorization beyond basic authentication. Admin endpoints must require role-based access control or a distinct elevated privilege check.
patterns.message: Route '{target}' in {file} is an admin endpoint but uses only standard auth. Apply elevated authorization (role check, admin permission) in addition to authentication.
